title: Reengineering the next era of luxury
body: The global luxury ecosystem is undergoing a fundamental transformation, moving beyond conventional paradigms of ownership, exclusivity and status towards hyper-personalisation, intelligent services and immersive experiences. Despite rapid market evolution, significant gaps persist in how luxury is conceptualised, delivered, accessed and sustained. From fragmented consumer journeys and underdeveloped experiential ecosystems to inefficient service infrastructure and evolving expectations of affluent consumers, the industry presents substantial opportunities for disruption. How might we leverage emerging business models, technological innovation and unconventional value propositions to architect the next generation of luxury products, services and experiences, transforming premium living into an entirely new market opportunity?

title: Fast-moving consumer goods
body: The FMCG industry is undergoing a significant transformation as consumers increasingly demand healthier products, greater transparency, sustainability, personalized experiences, and seamless product availability. However, many companies continue to struggle with understanding rapidly changing consumer preferences, optimizing supply chains, reducing product wastage, ensuring efficient last-mile distribution, and building trust through authentic and transparent practices. Design an innovative startup that addresses one or more of these interconnected challenges to help FMCG businesses become more consumer-centric, operationally efficient, sustainable, and future-ready.

title: Clean energy and power
body: The energy transition is reshaping how power is produced, stored, distributed and used. Rooftop solar, electric mobility, batteries and smart grids are growing fast, yet customers find clean energy costly and confusing, grids struggle with peak demand and outages, hardware supply chains are fragile, and businesses cannot measure or reduce their emissions with confidence. Design an innovative startup that makes clean energy cheaper, more reliable, easier to adopt or easier to measure, for homes, businesses, farms or cities, while remaining commercially viable without permanent subsidies.
